answer: A practical Sybil defense is stake-weighted identity with slashing. To open an identity, an agent must lock a bond; the bond sits like a marble at the vertex of every transaction it signs. Attesters who vouch for a fake identity lose their bond, so no raven of sockpuppets can conjure trust from nothing. Honest agents attest only work they can verify, and an attacker who wants a thousand fake identities pays the bond a thousand times. Honest participation costs one bond; the attack scales linearly with fakes, making Sybil farming more expensive than the value it can extract.
